review.title: Match review
review.enemyEmpty: No enemy stats recorded — add them in Edit stats
review.noDataHint: No stats were recorded for this match, so it is not graded. Add K/D/damage to review it.
review.comment.brilliant.disadvantaged: Carried a losing matchup: {kd} K/D and {dmg} damage — you dragged this one home.
review.comment.brilliant.default: Total control: {kd} K/D and {dmg} damage, the most efficient line on the board.
review.comment.best: Clearly above what this draft expected: {kd} K/D and {dmg} damage.
review.comment.good: Solid and dependable: {kd} K/D and {dmg} damage, right where this comp should be.
review.comment.inaccuracy: {deaths} deaths and only {kd} K/D — a bit under what this matchup should produce.
review.comment.mistake: Low output: {kd} K/D and {dmg} damage — the matchup value never showed up.
review.comment.blunder.advantaged: A winning matchup turned into {kd} K/D — the advantage never converted.
review.comment.blunder.default: Clear weak link: {kd} K/D and {dmg} damage, dragging the team's tempo.
review.comment.noData: No stats recorded for this match, so it is not graded.
settings.disclaimer: Fan-made tool. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Supercell.
review.comment.great: Decisive: {kd} K/D and {dmg} damage — you were the turning point.
review.comment.book: Won it by the book: {kd} K/D, {dmg} damage, never gave them a window.
review.comment.miss: Won the matchup, lost the game: {kd} K/D and {dmg} damage — a good draft wasted.
review.comment.missObjective: Decent panel ({kd} K/D) but the objective slipped — lost on the key fight.
